open_issues.description: This is chunk 1 of 2. The input candidate list includes passage IDs beyond P000134 (e.g., P000143, P000147, P000152 through P000180) that belong to chunk 2 and were not read here. Any economics there (e.g., Article 5, Article 19 cross-references, later amendments or schedules) require cross-chunk reconciliation.

Sublicense fee tiers (25%/10%/5%) are keyed to cumulative Aggregate Sublicense Fees but payments are based on fees received each calendar year; the text does not say whether tiers apply marginally or to all fees, so calculation is recorded as UNKNOWN. Boundary treatment at exactly $250,000 and $2,000,000 is also unclear.

The $1,000,000 annual maximum in 7.1 is stated 'up to a maximum' and it is unclear whether it caps only the 1% earned royalty or aggregate payments; the separate 25%-of-total-annual-revenue ceiling in 4.5 uses undefined 'total annual revenue' and its interaction with fees, minimums and milestones is unclear.

Net Sales includes sales by Sublicensees at a 1% royalty rate, while sublicense fees exclude earned royalties on net sales; whether any separate royalty share applies to Sublicensee sales royalties received by Licensee is not stated in this chunk.

Recitals jump from B to E and omit C and D; numbering anomalies also appear (e.g., 3.2.2 and 7.8 placement, '7.4' sections). Possible omitted text could contain additional economics; the license-issue fee dollar amount is not stated.

Milestone 7.7(e) formula depends on share counts and per-share price not available in the document; the 7.7(d) crediting limit is stated to apply to 'the foregoing milestone payments' though 7.7(e) is separately non-creditable.
No amendments were identified in this chunk, and an historical SEC exhibit does not establish current operative status; amendment history was not checked.

This chunk contains no royalty rates, tiers, sublicense royalties or minimums. All royalty economics (Article 4, 7, Net Sales, etc.) are in chunk 1 and must be reconciled there. Article 5 is referenced for prior patent costs and may govern crediting or timing; its content is not in this chunk.
The Effective Date, which sets the six-month installment window for prior patent costs, is not stated in this chunk; it must be taken from chunk 1.
Prior patent costs are stated as 'at least approximately $37,000', so the final amount is not fixed by the text.
Section 30.3 requires amendments in writing signed by both parties. No amendments are identified in this chunk, and operative status of this historical filing has not been checked.
